name: AI Cores Store
desc: Highly illegal store (According to Hegemony and Luddites solely) which sells various 'Christmas Balls' possessing high level of artifical intelligence

name: Derelict AI Market
desc: This store sells Drone Ships of Domain Explorarium pattern, these piles of junk are much scattered over the sector and Scavengers bring these alot. Also sells weaponry used by them as well.

name: Remnant AI Market
desc: This store sells Drone Ships of Remnant pattern and their equipment, lying and decaying in some Tri-Tachyon stockpile from AI Wars era, since Hegemony sanctions forbid using these. Also sells weaponry used by them as well.

name: Transcendent Forge
desc: By reaching transcendant level of knowledge and skill, you have impressed the Omega, and they offered some of their tech to you as reward in respect

name: Faction of the Month
desc: This store offers a rotating stock of ships, weapons, and other goods. Every month, its inventory changes, giving visitors something new to discover.

name: Lion's Guard Market
desc: This Shipyard sells Lion's Guard vessels, the Phillip Andrada's most Elite ships, wings and weaponry to most loyal Sindrian Diktat allies

name: Phase Emporium
desc: Market run by a mysterious trader, specializing in advanced phase ships. Here you can find agile vessels with unique combat capabilities.

name: Building Your Shit
desc: Hey scav, I have deal for ya, send me blueprints you found in outer space, and I'll build these for sale, I get the money, you got your stuff built. Good deal... Unless you have own planet with industry of course.
